notes.title: Bonfires of Azure – Expansion & Economy Update! 🔥
notes.content:
This update brings new mechanics, better economy balance, and more control over your city-building experience. Whether you’re expanding your settlement, fine-tuning your strategy, or just vibing to the improved soundtrack, there’s something for everyone!

🏗️ What’s New?

Resource gathering Buildings now have placement restrictions, so no more placing Woodcutters in the middle of stone fields. 

You can now pan left and right on the main map to explore more of your cozy town.

Clicking on the Bonfire now grants coins! Who knew warmth could be so profitable?

Prices for buildings have been rebalanced a bit to create a more natural resource flow.

Some structures, like the Tool Maker and Blacksmith, can now only be built within the city walls, reinforcing the importance of city planning.

The soundtrack has been improved to enhance the relaxing and immersive atmosphere of your growing town.

💬 Your Feedback Matters!
As always, this is just the beginning, and we’d love to hear what you think! Your feedback on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3489620/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] helps us improve the game and make Bonfires of Azure the best cozy city-building idler it can be.

🔥 Keep building, keep optimizing, and enjoy the warmth of the Bonfire! 🔥

- The Bonfires of Azure Team

notes.title: 🔥 Bonfires of Azure – Demo Release! 🔥
notes.content:
We’re a small team who originally started this project as an idler game, but… things got out of hand. Bonfires of Azure has now evolved into a mix of an idler and a city builder, where you grow your settlement at a relaxed pace while carefully placing buildings for the best bonuses.

This demo is a very early version of the game. It’s full of bugs, incomplete, and still finding its shape—but we’re excited to share it with you and hear what you think!

🌿 What’s Coming Next?
This is just the beginning! Here’s what we’re planning to add in future updates:

[list]
[*] Quests & Events, something fun to guide your building efforts toward some rewards and achievements.
[*] Your city will start feeling alive with characters and NPC's who bring their own stories.
[*] These are just the beginning Tiers, more advanced structures are coming for you to play with.
[*] Special Buildings with unique mechanics, break the core mechanics with unique building abilities.
[*] New islands to build on, try to build an effective town on islands of different shapes and sizes, also new biomes!
[*] Bug fixes & improvements!
[/list]

💬 Try the Demo & Share Your Thoughts!
We’d love for you to try the Bonfires of Azure demo and let us know what you think. Your feedback on Steam will help us improve and shape the future of the game.

Thank you for being part of this early stage—there’s a lot more to come! 🔥

The Bonfires of Azure Team
